Framework Laws Subject Matter Other Notes This consolidated
version of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania
incorporates all the amendments up to the Law on Constitutional
Referendum No. 2017-022 of August 15, 2017. Article 10 of the
Constitution stipulates that "The State guarantees to all citizens the
public and individual freedoms, notably (...) the freedom of
intellectual, artistic and scientific creation (...)".
